[package]
authors = ["Damir Jelić <poljar@termina.org.uk>"]
description = "A high level Matrix client-server library."
edition = "2024"
homepage = "https://github.com/matrix-org/matrix-rust-sdk"
keywords = ["matrix", "chat", "messaging", "ruma", "nio"]
license = "Apache-2.0"
name = "matrix-sdk"
readme = "README.md"
repository = "https://github.com/matrix-org/matrix-rust-sdk"
rust-version = "1.93"
version = "0.18.0"

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
features = ["docsrs"]
rustdoc-args = ["--cfg", "docsrs", "--generate-link-to-definition"]

[features]
default = ["e2e-encryption", "automatic-room-key-forwarding", "sqlite"]
testing = ["matrix-sdk-sqlite?/testing", "matrix-sdk-indexeddb?/testing", "matrix-sdk-base/testing", "wiremock", "matrix-sdk-test", "assert_matches2"]
e2e-encryption = ["matrix-sdk-base/e2e-encryption", "matrix-sdk-sqlite?/crypto-store", "matrix-sdk-indexeddb?/e2e-encryption"]
js = ["matrix-sdk-common/js", "matrix-sdk-base/js"]
sqlite = ["dep:matrix-sdk-sqlite", "matrix-sdk-sqlite?/state-store", "matrix-sdk-sqlite?/event-cache"]
bundled-sqlite = ["sqlite", "matrix-sdk-sqlite?/bundled"]
indexeddb = ["matrix-sdk-indexeddb/state-store", "matrix-sdk-indexeddb/event-cache-store", "matrix-sdk-indexeddb/media-store"]
qrcode = ["e2e-encryption", "matrix-sdk-base/qrcode"]
automatic-room-key-forwarding = ["e2e-encryption", "matrix-sdk-base/automatic-room-key-forwarding"]
experimental-send-custom-to-device = ["e2e-encryption", "matrix-sdk-base/experimental-send-custom-to-device"]
experimental-encrypted-state-events = ["e2e-encryption", "matrix-sdk-base/experimental-encrypted-state-events", "matrix-sdk-sqlite/experimental-encrypted-state-events", "matrix-sdk-test?/experimental-encrypted-state-events"]
experimental-push-secrets = ["e2e-encryption", "matrix-sdk-base/experimental-push-secrets", "matrix-sdk-sqlite?/experimental-push-secrets", "matrix-sdk-indexeddb?/experimental-push-secrets", "ruma/unstable-msc4385"]
markdown = ["ruma/markdown"]
socks = ["reqwest/socks"]
local-server = ["dep:axum", "dep:rand", "dep:tower"]
sso-login = ["local-server"]
federation-api = ["ruma/federation-api-c"]
uniffi = ["dep:uniffi", "matrix-sdk-base/uniffi", "dep:matrix-sdk-ffi-macros"]
experimental-widgets = ["dep:uuid", "experimental-send-custom-to-device"]
docsrs = ["e2e-encryption", "sqlite", "indexeddb", "sso-login", "qrcode", "federation-api"]
unstable-msc4274 = ["ruma/unstable-msc4274", "matrix-sdk-base/unstable-msc4274"]
experimental-search = ["matrix-sdk-search"]
experimental-element-recent-emojis = ["matrix-sdk-base/experimental-element-recent-emojis"]

[dependencies]
async-channel = "2.5.0"
event-listener = "5.4.1"
js_int = "0.2.2"
mime2ext = "0.1.54"
percent-encoding = "2.3.2"
tokio-util = "0.7.17"
urlencoding = "2.1.3"

[dependencies.anyhow]
optional = true
version = "1.0.100"
default-features = false

[dependencies.anymap2]
version = "0.13.0"
default-features = false

[dependencies.aquamarine]
version = "0.6.0"
default-features = false

[dependencies.as_variant]
version = "1.3.0"
default-features = false

[dependencies.assert_matches2]
optional = true
version = "0.1.2"
default-features = false

[dependencies.async-stream]
version = "0.3.6"
default-features = false

[dependencies.async-trait]
version = "0.1.89"
default-features = false

[dependencies.async-once-cell]
version = "0.5.4"
default-features = false

[dependencies.axum]
version = "0.8.4"
optional = true

[dependencies.bytes]
version = "1.11.1"
default-features = false
features = ["std"]

[dependencies.bytesize]
version = "2.3.0"
default-features = false
features = ["std"]

[dependencies.cfg-if]
version = "1.0.4"
default-features = false

[dependencies.eyeball]
version = "0.8.8"
default-features = false
features = ["tracing"]

[dependencies.eyeball-im]
version = "0.8.0"
default-features = false
features = ["tracing"]

[dependencies.eyre]
version = "0.6.12"
optional = true

[dependencies.futures-core]
version = "0.3.31"
default-features = false
features = ["std"]

[dependencies.futures-util]
features = ["async-await-macro", "std"]
version = "0.3.31"
default-features = false

[dependencies.http]
version = "1.3.1"
default-features = false

[dependencies.imbl]
features = ["serde"]
version = "6.1.0"
default-features = false

[dependencies.indexmap]
version = "2.12.1"
default-features = false

[dependencies.itertools]
version = "0.14.0"
default-features = false
features = ["use_std"]

[dependencies.language-tags]
version = "0.3.2"

[dependencies.matrix-sdk-base]
path = "crates/matrix-sdk-base"
version = "0.18.0"

[dependencies.matrix-sdk-common]
path = "crates/matrix-sdk-common"
version = "0.18.0"

[dependencies.matrix-sdk-ffi-macros]
optional = true
path = "bindings/matrix-sdk-ffi-macros"
version = "0.7.0"

[dependencies.matrix-sdk-indexeddb]
optional = true
path = "crates/matrix-sdk-indexeddb"
version = "0.18.0"
default-features = false

[dependencies.matrix-sdk-search]
optional = true
path = "crates/matrix-sdk-search"
version = "0.18.0"

[dependencies.matrix-sdk-sqlite]
optional = true
path = "crates/matrix-sdk-sqlite"
version = "0.18.0"
default-features = false

[dependencies.matrix-sdk-test]
optional = true
path = "testing/matrix-sdk-test"
version = "0.18.0"

[dependencies.mime]
version = "0.3.17"
default-features = false

[dependencies.oauth2]
version = "5.0.0"
default-features = false
features = ["timing-resistant-secret-traits"]

[dependencies.oauth2-reqwest]
version = "0.1.0-alpha.3"
default-features = false

[dependencies.pin-project-lite]
version = "0.2.16"
default-features = false

[dependencies.rand]
optional = true
version = "0.10.1"
default-features = false
features = ["std", "std_rng", "thread_rng"]

[dependencies.ruma]
features = ["rand", "unstable-msc2448", "unstable-msc3930", "unstable-msc3245-v1-compat", "unstable-msc4108", "unstable-msc4278", "client-api-c", "compat-unset-avatar", "compat-upload-signatures", "compat-arbitrary-length-ids", "compat-tag-info", "compat-encrypted-stickers", "compat-lax-room-create-deser", "compat-lax-room-topic-deser", "unstable-msc3230", "unstable-msc3401", "unstable-msc3417", "unstable-msc3488", "unstable-msc3489", "unstable-msc4075", "unstable-msc4140", "unstable-msc4143", "unstable-msc4171", "unstable-msc4195", "unstable-msc4278", "unstable-msc4286", "unstable-msc4306", "unstable-msc4308", "unstable-msc4310"]
version = "0.16.0"

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1.0.228"
default-features = false
features = ["std", "rc", "derive"]

[dependencies.serde_html_form]
version = "0.4.0"
default-features = false

[dependencies.serde_json]
version = "1.0.145"
default-features = false
features = ["std"]

[dependencies.sha2]
version = "0.10.9"
default-features = false

[dependencies.tempfile]
version = "3.23.0"
default-features = false

[dependencies.thiserror]
version = "2.0.17"
default-features = false

[dependencies.tokio-stream]
features = ["sync"]
version = "0.1.17"
default-features = false

[dependencies.tower]
version = "0.5.2"
features = ["util"]
optional = true

[dependencies.tracing]
features = ["attributes", "std"]
version = "0.1.41"
default-features = false

[dependencies.uniffi]
optional = true
version = "0.31.0"
default-features = false
features = ["cargo-metadata"]

[dependencies.url]
features = ["serde"]
version = "2.5.7"
default-features = false

[dependencies.uuid]
features = ["serde", "v4"]
optional = true
version = "1.18.1"
default-features = false

[dependencies.vodozemac]
version = "0.10.0"
default-features = false
features = ["libolm-compat", "insecure-pk-encryption", "experimental-session-config"]

[dependencies.zeroize]
version = "1.8.2"
default-features = false

[target."cfg(not(target_family = \"wasm\"))".dependencies]
backon = "1.6.0"

[target."cfg(not(target_family = \"wasm\"))".dependencies.reqwest]
features = ["stream", "gzip", "http2", "rustls"]
version = "0.13.1"
default-features = false

[target."cfg(not(target_family = \"wasm\"))".dependencies.tokio]
features = ["fs", "rt", "macros", "sync"]
version = "1.48.0"
default-features = false

[target."cfg(not(target_family = \"wasm\"))".dependencies.wiremock]
optional = true
version = "0.6.5"
default-features = false

[target."cfg(not(target_family = \"wasm\"))".dev-dependencies]
ctor = "0.2.9"

[target."cfg(not(target_family = \"wasm\"))".dev-dependencies.proptest]
version = "1.9.0"
default-features = false
features = ["std"]

[target."cfg(not(target_family = \"wasm\"))".dev-dependencies.tokio]
features = ["rt-multi-thread", "macros", "sync"]
version = "1.48.0"
default-features = false

[target."cfg(not(target_family = \"wasm\"))".dev-dependencies.wiremock]
version = "0.6.5"
default-features = false

[target."cfg(target_family = \"wasm\")".dependencies.gloo-timers]
features = ["futures"]
version = "0.3.0"
default-features = false

[target."cfg(target_family = \"wasm\")".dependencies.reqwest]
features = ["gzip", "http2", "rustls"]
version = "0.13.1"
default-features = false

[target."cfg(target_family = \"wasm\")".dependencies.tokio]
features = ["macros", "sync"]
version = "1.48.0"
default-features = false

[target."cfg(target_family = \"wasm\")".dev-dependencies.wasm-bindgen-test]
version = "0.3.55"
default-features = false
features = ["std"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"android\")".dependencies]
rustls = "0.23.38"
rustls-pki-types = "1.14.0"
rustls-native-certs = "0.8.3"
webpki-roots = "1.0.6"

[dev-dependencies]
dirs = "6.0.0"
serde_urlencoded = "0.7.1"
tokio-test = "0.4.4"

[dev-dependencies.anyhow]
version = "1.0.100"
default-features = false

[dev-dependencies.assert-json-diff]
version = "2.0.2"
default-features = false

[dev-dependencies.assert_matches]
version = "1.5.0"
default-features = false

[dev-dependencies.assert_matches2]
version = "0.1.2"
default-features = false

[dev-dependencies.futures-executor]
version = "0.3.31"
default-features = false
features = ["std"]

[dev-dependencies.insta]
version = "1.44.1"
features = ["json", "redactions"]

[dev-dependencies.matrix-sdk-base]
features = ["testing"]
path = "crates/matrix-sdk-base"
version = "0.18.0"

[dev-dependencies.matrix-sdk-test]
path = "testing/matrix-sdk-test"
version = "0.18.0"

[dev-dependencies.matrix-sdk-test-utils]
path = "testing/matrix-sdk-test-utils"
version = "0.18.0"

[dev-dependencies.similar-asserts]
version = "1.7.0"
default-features = false

[dev-dependencies.stream_assert]
version = "0.1.1"
default-features = false

[dev-dependencies.tracing-subscriber]
features = ["env-filter", "std", "smallvec", "fmt"]
version = "0.3.20"
default-features = false

[[test]]
name = "integration"
required-features = ["testing"]

[lints.rust]
rust_2018_idioms = "warn"
semicolon_in_expressions_from_macros = "warn"
unused_extern_crates = "warn"
unused_import_braces = "warn"
unused_qualifications = "warn"
trivial_casts = "warn"
trivial_numeric_casts = "warn"

[lints.rust.unexpected_cfgs]
level = "warn"
check-cfg = ["cfg(tarpaulin_include)", "cfg(ruma_unstable_exhaustive_types)"]

[lints.clippy]
assigning_clones = "allow"
box_default = "allow"
cloned_instead_of_copied = "warn"
dbg_macro = "warn"
inefficient_to_string = "warn"
macro_use_imports = "warn"
manual_let_else = "warn"
mut_mut = "warn"
needless_borrow = "warn"
nonstandard_macro_braces = "warn"
redundant_clone = "warn"
str_to_string = "warn"
todo = "warn"
unnecessary_semicolon = "warn"
unused_async = "warn"
